entity.name: Somdipto Nandy
entity.description: Independent builder in Bengaluru, India, working on open-source, local-first AI agent tooling.

projects.name: Dani Bot (dani-desktop)
projects.description: Apache-2.0, local-first desktop app (macOS/Windows/Ubuntu) where each chat is a real AI agent running on the user's own claude/codex/grok CLIs. A local harness server owns agent processes; transcripts and keys stay on disk. Agents can use an isolated local VM, a cloud Linux desktop, or opt-in host control.

channels.description: Bank transfer to the maintainer in India; details shared privately on request.

plans.name: Compute and maintenance
plans.description: Inference compute for cross-platform end-to-end agent testing, plus maintainer time to harden the VM/host-control safety boundary and ship a stable release.
